thread:
liam chen: Heads up — planning a maintenance window Tue 2025-06-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll roll kernel + NIC firmware on GPU fleets in us-east1 and eu-west1. Plan is rolling node drains, one node at a time per AZ, aiming to keep <10% capacity reduction per AZ. tagging infra-oncall

maria gonzalez: Thanks. Any impact to Dedicated pools or reserved capacity? We have a few enterprise jobs that run overnight, want to avoid evicting reserved allocations.

ben thompson: We should pre-warm Dedicated pools and bump cluster autoscaler mins for the window. Suggest +8 nodes across the two regions and disable scale-down during the job. Also can we do a canary in us-east1 first?

liam chen: Agreed on canary. Plan: drain 1 GPU host in us-east1-a, wait 30m smoke checks, then continue. We'll hold off on draining dedicated-tagged nodes; instead we'll live-migrate workloads where possible.

sarah patel: Add this to the runbook: before draining run `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>` then cordon+drain with force fallback after 20m. And set CA min nodes so we don't autoscale below target. Example commands: ```bash
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
```

jules kim: NIC firmware reboots can briefly drop IP routes. Do we need to reassign ephemeral IPs or reattach accelerated network interfaces? We should test a reboot on staging NICs tonight.

liam chen: Staging test scheduled for tonight 23:00 UTC. We'll verify IP persistence and run end-to-end inference smoke tests. If NIC requires reattach, we'll script ephemeral IP rebinds.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket INFRA-2247 created and linked to PD-12345. Notebook with playbook: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-2247/playbook

maria gonzalez: Product team: please prepare a status page blurb + customer email for Dedicated customers. Recommended copy: "Planned maintenance may cause brief interruptions for GPU-backed workloads in us-east1 and eu-west1. We expect no disruption to reserved capacity; if you have concerns contact support."

ben thompson: Cost note: pre-warming + extra nodes ~ estimate $1.8k–$2.5k for the window. I'll add to the budget tracker.

sarah patel: Oncall, please monitor autoscaler, pod evictions, and tail latency in the inference dashboards. We'll have a 1h post-mortem check-in after the window.

ops-oncall: PagerDuty schedule updated, maintenance window created PD-12345. I will page if autoscaler anomaly > 15% over baseline.

liam chen: Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you've read and are OK with the plan. I'll post the finalized start time and playbook link tomorrow AM.

maria gonzalez: :thumbsup:

ben thompson: :thumbsup:

sarah patel: :thumbsup:

jules kim: :thumbsup:
